text: Muddle and colleagues (191) decomposed EMG signals to provide more accurate insights into motor unit recruitment during low-load (30% maximal voluntary isometric contraction) versus high-load (70% maximal voluntary isometric contraction) training to muscular failure. Results showed that although fatigue brought about progressively greater recruitment of high-threshold motor units during light-load training, the extent of high-threshold recruitment was greater during heavier loading.
